result.topic_en: Euler considers the limiting case where the upper tube BC is very narrow (g nearly zero), simplifies the auxiliary quantities, and derives the pressure height R at CC to test whether the water remains continuous in the vessel.
result.transcription:
DE FRICTIONE FLVIDORVM. 365
ſeu $gg$ minimum, etiamſi eius altitudo BC ſit minima, tamen litterae $b$ valor notabilis tribui debebit; ac ſi BC quaſi euaneſcat, quod euenit, ſi fundus vaſis ſuperioris foramine exiguo fuerit pertuſus, nihilominus in calculo littera $b$ modicum valorem ſortietur.

72. Sit igitur amplitudo tubuli BC quaſi euaneſcens, ſeu $g$ fere nihilo aequalis, ita vt valor ipſius $b$ mediocrem nanciſcatur magnitudinem, etiamſi forte ipſa altitudo BC ſit minima; eritque $\frac{b}{g}$ numerus admodum magnus, ex quo valor ipſius $\mathfrak{B} = e^{\frac{-\alpha b}{g}}$ in fractionem abibit vnitate multo minorem, ita vt ſi eſſet $g=0$, omnino fuerit $\mathfrak{B}=0$. Praeterea vero euadet $\mathfrak{G} = \frac{k^4}{g^4}$ quantitas maxima. Quoniam vero amplitudines $ff$ et $hh$ non admodum paruae ſtatuuntur, erit $\mathfrak{A} = 1 - \frac{\alpha a}{f} + \frac{\alpha\alpha aa}{2ff}$; $\mathfrak{C} = 1 - \frac{\alpha c}{h} + \frac{\alpha^2 cc}{2hh}$ et $A = \frac{a}{f} - \frac{\alpha aa}{2ff}$ et $C = \frac{c}{h} + \frac{\alpha cc}{2hh}$.

73. Antequam autem ipſum effluxum definire queamus, videndum eſt, vtrum aqua in hoc vaſe continua manere, atque lateribus vaſis adhaerere queat; quem in finem quaeramus ſtatum compreſſionis aquae in CC, qui altitudine R exprimatur, eritque $l = R\mathfrak{C} + Ch + \mathfrak{H}v - v$, vnde reperitur:
$$R = \frac{l - Ch + (1-\mathfrak{H})v}{\mathfrak{C}}$$
quae quantitas ſi fuerit negatiua, aqua continua non manet, ideoque effluxus calculo aduerſabitur.

Zz 3 74. Cum

items.quote: videndum eſt, vtrum aqua in hoc vaſe continua manere, atque lateribus vaſis adhaerere queat
items.english: it must be seen whether the water in this vessel can remain continuous and adhere to the sides of the vessel

items.quote: quae quantitas ſi fuerit negatiua, aqua continua non manet, ideoque effluxus calculo aduerſabitur.
items.english: if this quantity is negative, the water does not remain continuous, and hence the outflow will contradict the calculation.
